answer.summary: A sparse monastery stepped down a sea cliff in terraces: a large chapel at the heart, five small cells on ledges, a refectory, a scriptorium, a bell tower at the top and a small landing at the foot. A carved stair joins the chapel ledge to the landing. The land isn't surveyed, so this needs a real slope with water below to fit.
